content.comment_body: Hello, Can anyone help me figure out what’s wrong with my [product_name] [version_no]? When I connect power, the display turns on, then switches off, showing a small symbol briefly before turning on again. There’s no text, just repeated flashing of that symbol with the display backlight.
It seems like your [product_name] might be defective.
If it is defective, I would like to know why. This [product_name] hasn’t been used before—I found it in storage and had forgotten about it.

I can't say for sure why your [product_name] is defective. Remote diagnosis is difficult. When I power my old [product_name] [article_no], the backlight comes on and an hourglass symbol appears, indicating startup. After a few seconds, the hourglass disappears and a flashing prompt for date and time setup appears. A bit later, the backlight goes off but the date/time prompt remains until you set it.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing an issue where the [product_name]'s display repeatedly flashes a symbol without text, failing to start up properly. There is frustration due to lack of error feedback from the device. Users compare this problem to standard startup behavior in other hardware versions but mention the absence of in-product troubleshooting guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to start normally, showing setup prompts like date and time, and to provide clear indicators or messages if there is a hardware problem.
